faq.can_change_plan: Can I change my subscription plan?
faq.can_change_plan_answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your subscription plan at any time. Changes will be reflected in your next billing cycle.
faq.payment_methods: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.payment_methods_answer: We accept all major credit cards and digital payment methods for your convenience.
faq.free_trial_answer: Yes, start with our Free plan to explore the platform. You can upgrade to a paid plan anytime.
faq.cancel_subscription_answer: You can cancel your subscription anytime. Your access will continue until the end of your current billing period.
faq.usage_limits: What do the usage limits mean?
faq.usage_limits_answer: Each plan includes specific limits on conversations, messages, and interactive minutes per month. Unlimited plans (0 or no limit) provide unrestricted access to that feature.
